hooks.command: name="$(tmux display-message -p '#S' 2>/dev/null || basename "$PWD")"; name="${name//\"/}"; osascript -e "display notification \"$name — done\" with title \"Claude Code finished\"" 2>/dev/null; afplay -v 4 /System/Library/Sounds/Submarine.aiff 2>/dev/null || true

name="$(tmux display-message -p '#S' 2>/dev/null || basename "$PWD")"; name="${name//\"/}"; osascript -e "display notification \"$name — needs input\" with title \"Claude Code waiting\"" 2>/dev/null; afplay -v 4 /System/Library/Sounds/Funk.aiff 2>/dev/null || true
